name: Marianelli
source:
The protagonist maid.
She is the most inexperienced maid. She is a former mercenary who was left to die in one of her missions but was rescued and then nursed over by the protagonist. Due to this she left the field and decided to dedicate her everything to him.
She used to wear a bikini armor during her mercenary days (She states her armor gave protection while not impacting her speed).
